name: Original cyborg body
limitations: Cola supply is finite, unmodified back is vulnerable, and original hardware has no Radical Beam, General suit or extra vehicles.

name: Trained cyborg body / Radical Beam
limitations: Body-mounted laser has charge/aim/resource needs; no General armor and cannon firing simultaneously. Finite cola, vulnerable transitions and ordinary equipment damage remain.

name: General Franky / piloted mecha
limitations: Supported finite piloted armor, not another teammate. General Cannon belongs to mecha position; pilot Radical Beam requires exiting/repositioning and is excluded from this locked-mecha move list. Cola, exposed transitions and equipment damage matter.
